verses.arabicText: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
verses.transliteration: Yāayyuhā l-muzamil
verses.translation: O you wrapped ˹in your clothes˺

verses.arabicText: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Qumi al-layla illā qalīlā
verses.translation: Stand all night ˹in prayer˺ except a little—

verses.arabicText: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Niṣ'fahu awi unquṣ min'hu qalīlā
verses.translation: ˹pray˺ half the night, or a little less

verses.arabicText: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Aw zid ʿalayhi warattili l-qur'āna tartīlā
verses.translation: or a little more—and recite the Quran ˹properly˺ in a measured way

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Innā sanul'qī ʿalayka qawlan thaqīlā
verses.translation: ˹For˺ We will soon send upon you a weighty revelation

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Inna nāshi-ata al-layli hiya ashaddu waṭaw-wa-aqwamu qīlā
verses.translation: Indeed, worship in the night is more impactful and suitable for recitation

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Inna laka fī n-nahāri sabḥan ṭawīlā
verses.translation: For during the day you are over-occupied ˹with worldly duties˺

verses.arabicText: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabtīlā
verses.translation: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly

verses.arabicText: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-ittakhidh'hu wakīlā
verses.translation: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the east and the west. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, so take Him ˹alone˺ as a Trustee of Affairs

verses.arabicText: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Wa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-uh'jur'hum hajran jamīlā
verses.translation: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say, and depart from them courteously

verses.arabicText: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Wadharnī wal-mukadhibīna ulī n-naʿmati wamahhil'hum qalīlā
verses.translation: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
verses.transliteration: Inna ladaynā ankālaw-wajaḥīmā
verses.translation: ˹For˺ We certainly have shackles, a ˹raging˺ Fire

verses.arabicText: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.transliteration: Waṭaʿāman dhā ghuṣṣatiw-waʿadhāban alīmā
verses.translation: choking food, and a painful punishment ˹in store for them˺

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Yawma tarjufu l-arḍu wal-jibālu wakānati l-jibālu kathībam-mahīlā
verses.translation: on the Day the earth and mountains will shake ˹violently˺, and mountains will be ˹reduced to˺ dunes of shifting sand

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
verses.transliteration: Innā arsalnā ilaykum rasūlan shāhidan ʿalaykum kamā arsalnā ilā fir'ʿawna rasūlā
verses.translation: Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh

verses.arabicText: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Faʿaṣā fir'ʿawnu r-rasūla fa-akhadhnāhu akhdhaw-wabīlā
verses.translation: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a stern grip

verses.arabicText: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
verses.transliteration: Fakayfa tattaqūna in kafartum yawmay-yajʿalu l-wil'dāna shībā
verses.translation: If you ˹pagans˺ persist in disbelief, then how will you guard yourselves against ˹the horrors of˺ a Day which will turn children’s hair grey

verses.arabicText: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
verses.transliteration: As-samāu munfaṭirun bihi kāna waʿduhu mafʿūlā
verses.translation: It will ˹even˺ cause the sky to split apart. His promise ˹of judgment˺ must be fulfilled

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.transliteration: Inna hādhihi tadhkiratun faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīlā
verses.translation: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord

verses.arabicText: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
verses.transliteration: Inna rabbaka yaʿlamu annaka taqūmu adnā min thuluthayi al-layli waniṣ'fahu wathuluthahu waṭāifatum-mina alladhīna maʿaka wal-lahu yuqaddiru al-layla wal-nahāra ʿalima al-lan tuḥ'ṣūhu fatāba ʿalaykum fa-iq'raū mā tayassara mina l-qur'āni ʿalima an sayakūnu minkum marḍā waākharūna yaḍribūna fī l-arḍi yabtaghūna min faḍli l-lahi waākharūna yuqātilūna fī sabīli l-lahi fa-iq'raū mā tayassara min'hu wa-aqīmū ṣ-ṣalata waātū z-zakata wa-aqriḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanaw-wamā tuqaddimū li-anfusikum min khayrin tajidūhu ʿinda l-lahi huwa khayraw-wa-aʿẓama ajraw-wa-is'taghfirū l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrur-raḥīm
verses.translation: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. So recite ˹in prayer˺ whatever you can from the Quran. He knows that some of you will be sick, some will be travelling throughout the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and some fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite whatever you can from it. And ˹continue to˺ perform ˹regular˺ prayers, pay alms-tax, and lend to Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah far better and more rewarding. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
